'''Uwari beetles''' were six-legged [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] that lived in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The local [[Myyydril]] tribe used domesticated Uwari beetles as a food source.

One particularly large and dangerous Uwari beetle was called [[Deathswarm]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Uwari beetles appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
